High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Resources API.

Provides access to app resources (bitmaps, fonts, raw data) stored in the app bundle.

Imports

ffi

Procs

proc getResourceHandle(resourceId: uint32): ResHandle {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Get a handle to a resource by its ID. Equivalent to C function resource_get_handle(resource_id).

Resource IDs are generated at build time from package.json and defined as RESOURCE_ID_* constants.

proc load(handle: ResHandle; buffer: ptr uint8; maxLength: csize_t): csize_t {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Load resource data into a buffer. Equivalent to C function resource_load(h, buffer, max_length). Returns the number of bytes loaded. 
proc loadByteRange(handle: ResHandle; startOffset: uint32; buffer: ptr uint8;
                   numBytes: csize_t): csize_t {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Load a byte range from a resource. Equivalent to C function resource_load_byte_range(h, start_offset, buffer, num_bytes). Returns the number of bytes loaded.
